description: Last accepted state of every stage of the six core runs (nodal = CI-001, A/B = NU-001), reset to arclength by n_reparam.reparameterize at its own storage band K. shape_relative = max distance from the reset curve to the original curve over sigma_0 = L/(2 pi); speed ratios on a uniform grid of max(1024, 32(K+1)) nodes.
